pick.name: Cal.com (cloud free)
pick.why: Best pay-later for routing/teams/workflows; note open-source changes.
pick.free_limits: Free: single user, template workflows, Cal branding. Teams $12/user/mo annual
pick.license: proprietary cloud; public repo now MIT 'Cal.diy' (non-production)

alts.name: TidyCal
alts.why: Most generous free plan (unlimited booking types) if Google's free tier is too thin.
alts.free_limits: Free forever: unlimited bookings and booking types, 1 calendar, 1% fee on payments

alts.name: Google Calendar appointment schedules
alts.what: Booking page in Google Calendar with auto Meet links
alts.why: Zero new vendor, Meet links built in, and your AI Pro Google One storage tier likely unlocks premium booking features.
alts.free_limits: Personal account: one booking page. Premium (multiple pages, reminders, payments, multi-calendar checks) needs an eligible Workspace or Google One plan; Google AI Pro/Ultra is in the eligible list (per-feature chart not readable)

candidates.name: Cal.com
candidates.verdict: alt; production code went private ~Apr 2026, public repo is MIT Cal.diy

decision: Use Google's booking page because interviews already happen on Meet. Switch to TidyCal if you need several interview types for free, or Cal.com if you need routing forms and team scheduling.
note: Consolidated: one booking tool for interviews and sales calls. Cal.com Free has unlimited event types and a free Attio app, and it doesn't depend on the Google AI Pro perk that ends in Jan 2028. Google appointment schedules stay as the fallback.

verify.note: Same tool and free plan verified in the Sales track.
